cliInstall.promptMessage: Add Droid CLI to your terminal?
cliInstall.promptDetail:
This will add the "droid" command to your PATH, allowing you to run Droid from any terminal window.

You can change this later from the Factory menu.
cliInstall.successDetail: The "droid" command is now available in your terminal.
cliInstall.pathUpdated: Your PATH has been updated. You may need to restart your terminal or open a new terminal window for the changes to take effect.
cliInstall.pathRequiredMessage: Droid CLI installed, but PATH update required
cliInstall.pathRequiredDetail:
The CLI was installed but is not in your PATH.

{{instructions}}
cliInstall.errorDetail:
{{error}}

You can install the CLI manually from the documentation.
cliInstall.removedDetail: The "droid" command has been removed. You can reinstall it anytime from the Factory menu.
cliInstall.alreadyInstalledDetail: The "droid" command is available in your terminal.
